{{Quote|You know a slicer named Besrik?''"<br />"''Yeah. That who you've been looking for? Came by looking for some top-of-the-line cybernetic enhancement stims. Told him I'm fresh out.|Rass Ordo and a patron|<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />}}
'''Greb Besrik''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] from [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]].<ref name="Galactic Threads" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> Besrik worked alongside [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and her mercenary team. Sometime after [[Malgus's escape]], Besrik bypassed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] security checkpoint on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which his signature modulation pattern matched the one used to slice into [[Darth Malgus]]'s [[Prison/Legends|cell]] controls on [[Carrick Station]]. [[Jekiah Ordo]] provided information that Besrik was on Hoth, and [[Lana Beniko]] confirmed that her sources from Carrick Station had identified him as Besrik.<ref name="Galactic Threads" />

The [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]] [[Mission to Hoth (Third Galactic War)|traveled]] to Hoth to search for Besrik. They looked for clues at [[Shai Tenna's pleasure den]] which [[Unidentified Human patron|a patron]] told them that Besrik went looking for some top-of-the-line [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancement stims. Besrik then went to the wreckage of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' to meet [[Gane Klisson]], a [[White Maw]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. They talked about a deal for the stims, but Klisson told Besrik that the price had gone higher. The Commander and Rass arrived and overheard their conversation. During the fight that followed, Besrik took the opportunity to escape.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />

[[File:Greb_Besrik_and_his_droid.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Greb Besrik and his battle droid]]
After they [[Death/Legends|defeated]] Klisson, the Commander and Rass found Besrik again as he was trying to use a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] to defend himself. The Commander and Rass defeated Besrik and started questioning him. Besrik told them that he still worked for Shae Vizla, but he did not know her current location. He also claimed that Shae and Malgus were always together. Rass then called for someone to pick up Besrik and take him away.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Greb Besrik first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

If the player is affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Lana Beniko will mention [[Vaiken Spacedock]] instead of Carrick Station and that Besrik bypassed Imperial checkpoint on Hoth.<ref name="Galactic Threads" />

Greb's fate is determined in 3 choices:
# The player can choose to let [[Rass Ordo]] take him for questioning by the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] for no alignment.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />
# The player can choose to hand Greb to their respective factions to the ire of Rass and Jekiha for no alignment.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />
# For dark side points, the player can kill Greb.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />
